items.title_zh: 哈萨克斯坦推动钢铝出口商适应欧盟CBAM：实测排放或显著降低成本
items.title_en: Kazakhstan prepares steel and aluminium exporters for CBAM; verified emissions may reduce modeled costs
items.title_original: Kazakhstan’s exporters are being prepared to operate under CBAM
items.summary_zh: 【报道事实与模型预测分开】GMK Center 2026年11月16日报道，哈萨克斯坦贸易和一体化部及QazTrade在COP31讨论钢铁和铝出口商的排放监测、报告与独立核证。援引政府及国际贸易中心(ITC)/QazTrade研究：2025年哈萨克斯坦对欧盟钢铁出口约39.6万吨、3.37亿欧元，铝约11万吨、2.74亿欧元。研究在特定假设下估计四类产品若使用默认排放值，CBAM年度成本约1.14亿美元；采用经核实的实际排放数据，模拟值可能约减半至5700万美元。以上均为研究情景，不是已缴税额或已确定2027年账单。欧盟驻哈萨克斯坦代表团2026年6月9日公告证实ITC/QazTrade研究及实际排放数据的重要性。
items.summary_en: GMK Center reported on 16 Nov 2026 that Kazakhstan is preparing steel/aluminium exporters for EU CBAM monitoring and verification. A cited ITC/QazTrade scenario estimates roughly USD 114m under defaults versus USD 57m with verified actual emissions across four categories; these are model outputs, not assessed tax liabilities. EU Delegation confirmed the study in June.
items.impact_zh: 【出口研判】哈萨克斯坦等竞争来源加速实际排放核证，可能缩小其默认值下的CBAM成本劣势，影响欧洲客户对板坯、长材和其他钢材的采购比较。中国钢厂应尽早取得产品及前驱体的可核证实际排放值，与欧盟默认值逐项比较，并把不同来源的认证进度纳入客户报价评估。不能将研究估计金额当作中国或哈萨克斯坦法定税率。
items.impact_en: Competitor verification could reduce default-value cost disadvantages and change EU landed-cost comparisons. Chinese mills should secure verified product and precursor emissions and compare actual against default values; modeled costs are not legal rates.

items.title_zh: 欧盟2026/2498明确第三国已付碳价抵扣CBAM：中国全国ETS列入附件II，须扣除免费配额并证明真实支付
items.title_en: EU Regulation 2026/2498: CBAM credit for carbon prices effectively paid; China national ETS listed in Annex II
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2498 of 5 November 2026 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2023/956 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the conversion of the carbon price paid in a third country into a corresponding reduction in the number of CBAM certificates to be surrendered, the evidence of payment of that carbon price, the qualifications of the independent person and conditions to ascertain its independence and qualifications
items.summary_zh: 【正式法规】实施条例(EU)2026/2498于11月5日签署、11月16日公布，按第36条11月19日生效并自2026年1月1日起适用。第4条及附件II明确将China National Emissions Trading System列为符合相关机制定义的ETS，附件同步标注免费配额和履约责任上限；这不是认定每家中国钢厂均已实际付费或保证自动抵扣。第3、9条要求按具体产品对应的嵌入排放核算净已付碳价，扣除免费分配、返还与补偿；按第6条以报告年度官方年均汇率折欧元。第7条：采用独立核证的实际支付路径，减交CBAM证书量=单吨商品合格净已付碳价(欧元/吨商品)×申报吨数÷进口年度CBAM证书参考价格(欧元/吨CO₂)；采用欧委会默认碳价路径，按适用默认碳价(欧元/吨CO₂)×对应嵌入排放强度×申报吨数÷同一年度参考价换算。实际排放值可在合格实际碳价与默认碳价路径间选择；若嵌入排放用默认排放值，则仅能用官方默认碳价。第7(3)条的年度参考价为进口年度公布CBAM证书价格的平均值，不等于某次EUA成交价或单一季度价格。符合强制碳定价制度的履约碳信用可按限制计入；国际信用须符合《巴黎协定》第6条授权发行条件且最多为相关报告排放的10%。第11条允许符合条件的现有CBAM核查机构在2026—2027报告期暂承担已付碳价核证角色，2028年后须取得专项认可；过渡角色原则上最迟2028年9月30日终止。欧委会尚待发布各国默认碳价及方法，用于2027年9月30日前首轮CBAM申报。
items.summary_en: Regulation 2026/2498 was published 16 Nov, enters into force 19 Nov and applies from 1 Jan 2026. Annex II explicitly lists China's national ETS, with free allowances/liability cap—not an automatic credit. Deduct only verifiable net carbon prices attributed to CBAM-relevant embedded emissions, after rebates/free allocation. Actual-price route: certified EUR/tonne of goods × declared quantity ÷ annual CBAM reference price; default-price route: default EUR/tCO2 × embedded emissions intensity × quantity ÷ annual reference price. With default emission values, only default carbon prices may be claimed. Transitional verifier qualification covers 2026–27; special accreditation is needed from 2028. Default country carbon-price values are still forthcoming.
items.impact_zh: 【出口研判】对中国板坯、冷轧板等CBAM覆盖产品，国内ETS纳入并不等于全额按全国碳市场挂牌价减免。钢厂须证明有偿履约数量、实际支付与清缴凭证，按CBAM直接排放和前驱体等适用边界将碳价归属具体产品；国内ETS核算边界与CBAM边界可能不一致。可先比较欧委会未来默认碳价路径与独立核证的实际支付路径，避免为争取很小抵扣额付出过高审计成本。一般性示意：若1000吨进口钢材经核证净已付碳价为5欧元/吨商品，年度CBAM参考价为90欧元/吨CO₂，理论减交约55.56张证书；这不是中国实际碳价或2027年证书价格。2027年欧盟进口合同应区分CBAM法律缴证主体与商业成本分担，核对净成本是否扣除合格第三国碳价抵扣及相关资料责任；公开看板不披露任何客户私有合同条款。
items.impact_en: China ETS coverage does not automatically generate full EU credit. Mills need evidence of net paid allowances, surrender/payment and product-level attribution under CBAM boundaries, including relevant precursors. Compare default carbon-price and audited actual-price routes once Commission values are available. For 2027 EU imports, contract CBAM-sharing provisions should define net liability and data responsibilities without disclosing confidential customer terms.
items.follow_up: 钢厂财务/碳管理部门核对2026年度覆盖工序与CBAM产品边界、免费配额、履约缺口、购入配额成本/清缴凭证、退款补偿、前驱体及分品种碳价归属；确认核证机构能否承担2026—27年已付碳价核证；跟踪欧委会默认碳价与申报模板，比较默认和实际路径；欧盟进口商与合同方核对净CBAM成本分担。
items.coverage: 2026-11-17核对欧盟官方公报实施条例(EU)2026/2498第3—11、36条及附件I、II中中国ETS条目，并与DG TAXUD 2026-11-16正式通告交叉确认。公式为第7条变量关系的文字化表达；未使用未公布的中国默认碳价或具体钢厂实缴数据，也未据此判断具体合同已可减免。原采集published_date=2026-11-15为观察日期，官方公报日为2026-11-16。

items.title_zh: 欧盟2026/2547冷轧钢反倾销终裁：五地分企业征税3%—27.9%，11月17日生效
items.title_en: EU Regulation 2026/2547: definitive cold-rolled steel AD duties of 3–27.9% on five origins effective 17 November
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2547 of 13 November 2026 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain cold-rolled flat steel products originating in India, Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam
items.summary_zh: 【正式法规】欧委会2026年11月13日签署实施条例(EU)2026/2547，11月16日刊登官方公报，依第3条11月17日生效。针对原产印度、日本、台湾地区、土耳其和越南的部分未镀覆冷轧铁/非合金钢/其他合金钢扁平材（不锈钢除外）征最终反倾销税，税基为欧盟边境未完税净价。第1条分企业税率：印度JSW及其他均9.5%；日本日本制铁/大同特殊钢及其他均27.9%；台湾地区中钢、中鸿与附件所列合作企业20.7%、其他27.0%；土耳其Tatmetal 3.0%、附件合作企业4.9%、Borçelik及其他7.8%；越南POSCO Vietnam及其他16.0%。范围为部分CN 72091500、72091690、72091790、72091891、72091899、72092500、72092690、72092790、72092890、72112330、72112380、72112900、72255080、72269200，带ex的子目须核对TARIC细码。排除规定的电工钢、特定小于0.35毫米退火黑板卷、硅电钢、高速钢；已镀锌/涂层卷不因冷轧基板而自动涉案。适用个别企业税率须出示第1(3)条规定的签字商业发票及附加TARIC代码，否则按原产地其他企业税率。序言(1067)—(1070)认定本案未实施临时税，因此不追溯向此前登记进口征收本案最终反倾销税。欧委会还首次就印度铁矿石政府措施、台湾地区受中国冷轧供给影响的市场价格认定特殊市场状况(PMS)，属于调查方法重要先例。
items.summary_en: Regulation 2026/2547 was signed 13 Nov, published 16 Nov and takes effect 17 Nov. Definitive AD rates: India 9.5%; Japan 27.9%; Taiwan 20.7% for CSC/Chung Hung/listed cooperators and 27% otherwise; Türkiye 3% Tatmetal, 4.9% listed cooperators, 7.8% Borçelik/others; Vietnam 16%. Scope is specified uncoated cold-rolled flats (exclusions and CN/TARIC subcodes apply). Individual rates require a signed invoice declaration. No retroactive collection in this investigation (recitals 1067–1070). The Commission established particular market situations in India and Taiwan.
items.impact_zh: 【出口研判】欧盟采购日本及台湾地区普通CRC的税负增加可能改变服务中心、家电和部分汽车冷轧材采购比较；土耳其企业税率仅3%—7.8%，仍需按厂别评估竞争力。中国出口商不因第三国被征税而自动免除自身反倾销、保障措施配额、CBAM和认证门槛。对潜在订单应分别核对CN/TARIC、工厂、发票、放行日期及客户技术认证，再测算DDP/CFR到岸成本。受限竞争品种可能转向中东/北非等市场，属于需要实证跟踪的贸易转移风险，不是已发生的事实。PMS调查逻辑值得关注以后对第三国本地原料成本与中国供应链关系的审查。
items.impact_en: This decision changes EU landed-cost comparisons for Japanese and Taiwanese CRC while some Turkish producers remain competitive at lower rates. Chinese origin is not exempt from its own AD, safeguards, CBAM or customer qualification. Compare supplier-specific landed costs and watch for possible (not confirmed) trade diversion to MENA. The PMS method is relevant to future origin/cost investigations.
items.follow_up: 按五地实际生产企业、CN/TARIC附加码与发票核对欧盟客户的既有及新采购；列中国替代供应商对照表并分别计算自身税负、配额、CBAM和认证条件；关注中东及北非竞争报价，不把可能的贸易转移当成既成事实。

items.summary_zh: 【正式法规】欧盟执行条例(EU)2026/2547于11月13日通过、11月16日刊登，按第3条于11月17日生效。第1条规定：印度9.5%；日本27.9%；台湾合作企业20.7%、其他27%；土耳其Tatmetal 3%、Borçelik及其他企业7.8%、附件列明的其他合作企业4.9%；越南16%。税基为未完税欧盟边境净价。范围为特定未镀覆冷轧铁、非合金钢及其他合金钢扁平材，涉及部分7209、7211、7225、7226税号；不含不锈钢，另排除规定的电工钢、硅电钢、高速钢，以及厚度小于0.35毫米的退火卷状黑铁皮。企业单独税率须凭符合第1(3)条的商业发票声明，具体产品及TARIC附加码以条文和附件为准。
items.summary_en: Regulation (EU) 2026/2547 was adopted on 13 November, published on 16 November and enters into force on 17 November 2026 under Article 3. Article 1 sets duties of 9.5% for India, 27.9% for Japan, 20.7% for cooperating Taiwanese producers and 27% otherwise; Türkiye: Tatmetal 3%, Borçelik and residual imports 7.8%, other listed cooperators 4.9%; Vietnam 16%. Duties apply to the net Union-frontier price before duty. Specified uncoated cold-rolled iron/non-alloy/other-alloy flat products are covered under parts of CN 7209, 7211, 7225 and 7226. Stainless steel, specified electrical/silicon-electrical and high-speed steels, and annealed black-plate coils below 0.35 mm are excluded. Individual rates require the prescribed invoice declaration; consult Article 1 and the Annex for exact scope and additional TARIC codes.
items.impact_zh: 【业务研判】即使本案没有把中国大陆列为涉案原产地，也会改变欧盟进口冷轧的到岸成本比较。可向欧洲汽车、家电、服务中心客户核对上述来源在途与新采购，按具体钢厂税率、产品范围和交货时间重算报价；土耳其不同企业不能统一按最高税率估算。部分受影响供货可能转向中东、北非等市场，形成新的报价压力，这属于需跟踪的贸易转移情景。中国钢材是否具备替代机会仍需另核对其自身适用措施、配额、CBAM和客户认证，不能由本案推定自动受益。
items.impact_en: Business assessment: the measure changes EU landed-cost comparisons even though mainland China is not a named origin. Check customers’ shipments and sourcing plans against producer-specific duties, scope and delivery timing, particularly the differing Turkish rates. Diversion into the Middle East or North Africa could intensify price competition; this is a scenario to monitor, not an established outcome. Any substitution opportunity for Chinese steel still depends on its own applicable measures, quotas, CBAM and customer qualification.

The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism ( CBAM ) comes into effect on 1 January 2027. It will tax embodied emissions in specific carbon intensive goods imported into the UK. items.summary_zh: 【事实】11月5日意大利Ecomondo活动上，siderweb及RICREA组织行业讨论，指出EU ETS免费配额逐步退出、CBAM和新钢铁进口限制将改变生产商、贸易商及下游加工商成本。与会者认为进口压力减弱可能改善欧盟钢厂盈利，但能源、碳成本和下游竞争力仍受挤压。欧盟委员会官方文件确认2026年7月1日起年度免税钢材配额1830万吨，配额外税率50%。会议观点不等于新增法规。
items.summary_en: At the 5 Nov Ecomondo industry conference, speakers said EU CBAM, phased ETS free-allocation changes and tighter steel trade measures may support mills but increase downstream costs. Official EU guidance confirms the 18.3 Mt annual quota and 50% above-quota duty effective 1 July 2026; the conference itself created no new law.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】欧洲钢贸与加工中心可能面临库存成本、碳成本及替代进口制品压力，首钢钢卷订单应同时评估配额、CBAM和终端客户定价权。
items.impact_en: Assess combined quota, CBAM and distributor margin effects instead of treating conference views as legal amendments.

items.follow_up: 与德国、意大利钢贸客户确认2027年报价能否转嫁配额外关税和CBAM；以欧盟最新法条核对实际产品范围。

items.title_zh: 塞尔维亚财政战略预计2026年EU CBAM影响约1.402亿欧元，其中钢铁约8910万
items.title_en: Serbian fiscal strategy projects €140.2m CBAM exposure in 2026, €89.1m for steel
items.title_original: Expected CBAM impact on Serbia in 2026 to exceed €140 million
items.summary_zh: 【事实】塞尔维亚政府《2027年财政战略及2028—2029预测》附录估计，假定未获认可的本地碳定价机制、维持2025年出口水平、默认排放值及每吨75.36欧元碳价时，2026年出口EU的CBAM影响约1.402亿欧元，其中钢铁约8910万、铝约1950万、电力约2180万；预计钢铁部分2029年约1.085亿欧元。这是情景预测，不是实缴税款，也不是对中国钢材征税公告。
items.summary_en: Serbia's official fiscal strategy estimates €140.2m of 2026 EU CBAM exposure under baseline assumptions, with €89.1m attributed to iron and steel, €19.5m to aluminium and €21.8m to electricity. These are scenario estimates, not assessed taxes.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】对在塞尔维亚加工并向欧盟出售钢材的合作伙伴有成本参考价值，实际责任须使用工厂核实排放、配额及碳价。禁止简单按8910万欧元除吨数作为统一钢材CBAM税率。
items.impact_en: Benchmark for Serbian steel value chains, not a universal per-ton levy; verify plant emissions and importer allocation.

items.title_en: Indonesia Tsingshan raises stainless export offers by US$40/t
items.title_original: Indonesia Tsingshan adjusts stainless steel export rates upward amid raw material cost pressure
items.summary_zh: 【事实】Yieh Corp 11月6日报道，印尼青山将不锈钢出口报价提高40美元/吨，报道认为主要因镍及镍铁成本上升；伦敦金属交易所三个月期镍期价一度超过16200美元/吨。属于企业报价和市场报道，不是印尼出口关税调整。
items.summary_en: Yieh reported on 6 Nov that Indonesia Tsingshan raised its stainless export offer by US$40/t amid higher nickel-related feedstock costs. This is a market quotation move, not an export-tax change.

items.impact_en: Track stainless transaction prices and nickel feedstock; avoid extrapolating to carbon-steel coils.

items.title_zh: 美国对柬埔寨加工的中越钢丝衣架作出反规避肯定终裁
items.title_en: US final circumvention finding on wire hangers finished in Cambodia with Chinese/Vietnamese inputs
items.title_original: Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the People's Republic of China and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam: Final Affirmative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty Order on Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the People's Republic of China and the Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Orders on Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the Socialist Republic of Vietnam
items.summary_zh: 【事实】美国商务部2026年11月6日联邦公报文号2026-22658（91 FR 70055）认定：使用中国或越南生产的钢丝，或钢丝及纸质附件，在柬埔寨完成制造并出口美国的钢丝衣架，构成规避原有中国反倾销令或越南反倾销/反补贴令。美国海关继续对2025年8月12日及以后尚未最终清算的相关进口暂停清算并收取保证金。涉案命令A-570-918、A-552-812、C-552-813；并非对全部钢丝或钢卷出口新征税。
items.summary_en: Commerce's final 6 Nov 2026 decision (FR 2026-22658) finds Cambodia-finished wire garment hangers using Chinese or Vietnamese wire inputs circumvent existing AD/CVD orders; CBP continues suspension and cash deposits for relevant unliquidated entries from 12 Aug 2025. It is not a blanket duty on wire or flat steel.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】涉及中国钢丝—柬埔寨衣架加工—美国进口链条的客户应立即梳理投入原产地、最终用途和进口批次；普通钢卷/钢丝并不因本案自动纳入衣架税令。需以文字产品范围为准，而非仅凭HTS归类。
items.impact_en: Review Cambodia assembly and US entry records if supplying hanger wire; distinguish covered hangers from standalone steel inputs.

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) determines that imports of steel wire garment hangers (hangers), completed in Cambodia using: (1) steel wire or (2) steel wire and paper accessories, produced in the People's Republic of China (China) or the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Vietnam), are circumventing the antidumping duty (AD) order on hangers from China, or the AD and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on hangers from Vietnam.

items.source_excerpt: On October 27, 2026, the U.S. Court of International Trade (CIT) issued its final judgment in POSCO v. United States Consol. Court No. 24-00006, Slip Op. 26-131, sustaining the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce)'s second remand results pertaining to the administrative review of the countervailing duty (CVD) order on of certain carbon and alloy steel cut-to-length plate (CTL Plate) from the Republic of Korea (Korea) covering the period January 1, 2021, through December 31, 2021. Commerce is notifying the public that the CIT's final judgment is not in harmony with Commerce's final results of the administrative review, and that Commerce is amending the final results with respect to countervailable subsidy rate assigned to POSCO Co., Ltd. (POSCO).
